from pyspark.sql import functions as F

storage = "stwikilakedev01"

silver_path = f"abfss://silver@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/pageviews"
gold_path   = f"abfss://gold@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net"

print(gold_path)

dates = spark.sql(
    "SELECT explode(sequence(to_date('2026-01-01'), to_date('2027-12-31'), interval 1 day)) AS date"
)

dim_date = dates.select(
    F.date_format("date", "yyyyMMdd").cast("int").alias("date_key"),
    "date",
    F.year("date").alias("year"),
    F.month("date").alias("month"),
    F.date_format("date", "MMMM").alias("month_name"),
    F.dayofmonth("date").alias("day"),
    F.date_format("date", "EEEE").alias("weekday_name"),
    F.dayofweek("date").isin(1, 7).alias("is_weekend"),
)

dim_date.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").save(f"{gold_path}/dim_date")
dim_date.show(5)

fact = (
    silver
    .groupBy("view_date", "domain_code", "page_title", "is_article")
    .agg(
        F.sum("views").alias("views"),
        F.count("*").alias("active_hours"),
    )
    .withColumn("date_key", F.date_format("view_date", "yyyyMMdd").cast("int"))
    .select("date_key", "view_date", "domain_code", "page_title",
            "is_article", "views", "active_hours")
)

(
    fact.write
    .format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .option("replaceWhere", f"view_date = '{run_date}'")
    .partitionBy("view_date")
    .save(f"{gold_path}/fact_pageviews_daily")
)

print("Done")

fact_saved = (
    spark.read.format("delta").load(f"{gold_path}/fact_pageviews_daily")
    .filter(F.col("view_date") == run_date)
)

silver_views = silver.agg(F.sum("views")).first()[0]
fact_views   = fact_saved.agg(F.sum("views")).first()[0]

print("Fact rows:   ", fact_saved.count())
print("Silver views:", silver_views)
print("Fact views:  ", fact_views)
print("Same total:  ", silver_views == fact_views)

from pyspark.sql import Window

day_fact = fact_saved   # the fact rows for run_date

top_pages = (
    day_fact
    .filter(F.col("is_article"))
    .groupBy("date_key", "view_date", "page_title")
    .agg(
        F.sum("views").alias("views"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("domain_code").endswith(".m"), F.col("views")).otherwise(0))
         .alias("mobile_views"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.desc("views"))
    .limit(100)
    .withColumn("rank", F.row_number().over(
        Window.partitionBy("view_date").orderBy(F.desc("views"))
    ))
)

(
    top_pages.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite")
    .option("replaceWhere", f"view_date = '{run_date}'")
    .partitionBy("view_date")
    .save(f"{gold_path}/agg_top_pages_daily")
)

top_pages.orderBy("rank").show(10, truncate=False)

dim_wiki_df = spark.read.format("delta").load(f"{gold_path}/dim_wiki")

access_daily = (
    day_fact
    .groupBy("date_key", "view_date", "domain_code")
    .agg(
        F.sum("views").alias("views"),
        F.count("*").alias("pages"),
    )
    .join(dim_wiki_df.select("domain_code", "access"), "domain_code")
    .withColumn("view_share", F.round(
        F.col("views") / F.sum("views").over(Window.partitionBy("view_date")), 4
    ))
)

(
    access_daily.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite")
    .option("replaceWhere", f"view_date = '{run_date}'")
    .partitionBy("view_date")
    .save(f"{gold_path}/agg_access_daily")
)

access_daily.show()

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql import Window

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

run_day = datetime.strptime(run_date, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
start_day = run_day - timedelta(days=7)

last_8_days = (
    spark.read.format("delta").load(f"{gold_path}/fact_pageviews_daily")
    .filter(F.col("view_date").between(str(start_day), run_date))
    .filter(F.col("is_article"))
)

days_found = last_8_days.select("view_date").distinct().count()

if days_found < 8:
    print(f"Skipping trending: only {days_found} of 8 days available")
else:
    trending = (
        last_8_days
        .groupBy("page_title")
        .agg(
            F.sum(F.when(F.col("view_date") == run_date, F.col("views")).otherwise(0))
             .alias("views_today"),
            (F.sum(F.when(F.col("view_date") < run_date, F.col("views")).otherwise(0)) / 7)
             .alias("avg_prev_7"),
        )
        .filter(F.col("views_today") >= 1000)
        .withColumn("increase", F.round(F.col("views_today") - F.col("avg_prev_7"), 1))
        .withColumn("growth", F.round(F.col("views_today") / F.greatest(F.col("avg_prev_7"), F.lit(1)), 2))
        .orderBy(F.desc("increase"))
        .limit(100)
        .withColumn("view_date", F.lit(run_date).cast("date"))
        .withColumn("date_key", F.lit(int(run_date.replace("-", ""))))
        .withColumn("avg_prev_7", F.round("avg_prev_7", 1))
        .withColumn("rank", F.row_number().over(
            Window.partitionBy("view_date").orderBy(F.desc("increase"))
        ))
    )

    (
        trending.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite")
        .option("replaceWhere", f"view_date = '{run_date}'")
        .partitionBy("view_date")
        .save(f"{gold_path}/agg_trending_daily")
    )

    spark.read.format("delta").load(f"{gold_path}/agg_trending_daily") \
        .filter(F.col("view_date") == run_date) \
        .orderBy("rank") \
        .select("rank", "page_title", "views_today", "avg_prev_7", "increase", "growth") \
        .show(10, truncate=False)
